# Dom Vournias — Full-Stack Developer

> Portfolio and blog of Dom Vournias, a full-stack developer specialising in React, Next.js, SvelteKit, TypeScript, Supabase, and GraphQL. Based in Greece.

## About

Dom Vournias is a full-stack developer with 7+ years of experience building production web applications. He has worked on large-scale freelancer marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, and open-source tools. He studied Fine Arts and Film Production before transitioning into software development in 2017.

## Blog

Articles covering web development, SvelteKit, React, Next.js, and software engineering practices.

- https://domvournias.dev/blog/from-gatsby-to-sveltekit
- https://domvournias.dev/blog/how-to-add-blog-comments-to-gatsby
- https://domvournias.dev/blog/how-to-add-breakpoints-with-styled-components
